rows.ARS:
Light pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: WEKmeredoc
Exhibition name: Meredith (hybrid tea, Carruth 2002)
rows.Origin:
Bred by Tom Carruth (United States, 2002).
Introduced in United Kingdom by C & K Jones in 2007 as 'Chris Beardshaw'.
rows.Bloom: Light pink, darker undertones. Mild, sweet fragrance. Double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, in small clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Semi-glossy, medium green foliage.

Height: up to 35" (up to 90cm). Width: up to 2' (up to 60cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders or garden.
rows.Parentage:
Karen Blixen ™ ×
New Zealand (hybrid tea, McGredy 1988)
